def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(grid):
    # find separator rows/cols (uniform solid color spanning full width/height)
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    def solid(row): return len(set(row))==1 and row[0] not in (0,)
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(h) if solid(grid[i])]
    if sep_rows:
        i=sep_rows[0]
        A=[r for r in grid[:i]]; B=[r for r in grid[i+1:]]
        return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a,b in zip(x,y)] for x,y in zip(A,B)]
    # vertical separator column
    cols=list(zip(*grid))
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(w) if solid(list(cols[j]))]
    j=sep_cols[0]
    A=[r[:j] for r in grid]; B=[r[j+1:] for r in grid]
    return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a,b in zip(x,y)] for x,y in zip(A,B)]
